personal_token.label: Personal API key
personal_token.where: PostHog > Settings > Personal API keys > Create. Give it read scopes on the specific project rather than all access.
notes: PostHog personal keys are scoped and individually revocable, which is what makes them a reasonable choice here.
The key is for the private API. The project write key that appears in snippets is a different thing and cannot read.
PostHog documents personal API keys as the right choice for your own automations, and OAuth for an app other PostHog users install. A browser configured by its own user is the former.
Self-hosted instances use the same paths on their own host, so the API base has to be configurable rather than hard-coded to the cloud.

query.notes: HogQL. The general read path for anything analytical.

rate_limits.note: Roughly 240 per minute and 1200 per hour for most endpoints, lower for query. Returns 429.
